name: The King
source:
The king of the demon homeland.

In the outerlands, he's infamous for being a ruthless warrior, even being known to join the battles himself.

He's regarded as a tyrant who has no respect for life.

[From [url=https://reineworks.itch.io/mizari-loves-company]itch.io[/url]]
